_comment: Managed policy for the kiosk. Installed to /etc/chromium/policies/managed/. Together with the 'First Run' marker file in the player profile this stops the terms-of-service dialog that otherwise sits in front of the page on a fresh box.
_comment_updates: Nothing on this box should ever phone home or restart itself for an update.
_comment_autoplay: The controller page starts video on its own with no click, so autoplay has to be allowed outright.
_comment_restore: 5 is 'open the new tab page'. This kills 'continue where you left off', so a URL from a previous config can never come back after the URL is changed.
